name: Add an mTLS certificate
description: Add an mTLS certificate Adds a new mTLS root certificate to Access. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates
Adds a new mTLS root certificate to Access.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete an mTLS certificate
description: Delete an mTLS certificate Deletes an mTLS certificate. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/{certificate_id}

name: Get an mTLS certificate
description: Get an mTLS certificate Fetches a single mTLS certificate. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/{certificate_id}

name: List mTLS certificates
description: List mTLS certificates Lists all mTLS root certificates. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates
Lists all mTLS root certificates.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query)

name: List all mTLS hostname settings
description: List all mTLS hostname settings List all mTLS hostname settings for this account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/settings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/settings
List all mTLS hostname settings for this account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update an mTLS certificate
description: Update an mTLS certificate Updates a configured mTLS certificate. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/{certificate_id}

name: Update an mTLS certificate's hostname settings
description: Update an mTLS certificate's hostname settings Updates an mTLS certificate's hostname settings. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/settings
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/certificates/settings
Updates an mTLS certificate's hostname settings.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)
